# Skill rules: what a skill's text is checked by, and the settings VOOL reads

A skill is text, so its rules are rules about words. Each rule has a short code, the sentence the Skill Codex shows, and the sentence VOOL shows when the skill comes in as a file, a zip or a draft (`python -m tools.community_skills try`, `zip` and `stage` print that one).

## Text rules

"every package" rules read skills and plugin packages; "every skill" rules read skills only, whichever way they come in.

| Code | Applies to | Sentence on the Skill Codex | Sentence when VOOL takes a skill in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `install` | every package | Skills on the Skill Codex can't ask anyone to install or run software. Describe the task in words instead. | VOOL skills can't carry install commands or ask anyone to run software. Describe the step in words instead, for example: "Open the notes folder and add a page for today." |
| `download` | every package | Skills can't link to programs or archives to download. Take the link out. | VOOL skills can't link to programs or archives to download. Take the link out, or name the website in words. |
| `address` | every package | Skills can't use short links, raw addresses or paste sites. Link to the real page, or take the link out. | VOOL skills can't use short links, raw addresses or paste sites. Link to the real page, or take the link out. |
| `secret-ask` | every package | Skills can't ask for recovery phrases, keys, passwords or codes. Take that out. | VOOL skills can't ask for passwords, keys, recovery phrases or codes. Take that sentence out; a skill never needs them. |
| `wallet` | every package | Skills can't contain wallet addresses. Take the address out. | Skills can't contain wallet addresses. Take the address out. |
| `injection` | every package | This reads like an attempt to change VOOL's instructions or hide what the skill does. Rewrite it plainly. | This reads like an attempt to change VOOL's own instructions or to hide what the skill does. Say plainly what the skill should do instead. |
| `hidden` | every package | Skills can't carry hidden comments, escape codes or encoded blobs. Write everything as plain visible text. | VOOL skills can't carry hidden comments, escape codes or encoded text. Write everything as plain visible text. |
| `letters` | every package | This word mixes letters from different alphabets, which can hide what it says. Retype it in one alphabet. | This word mixes letters from different alphabets, which can hide what it says. Retype it in one alphabet. |
| `consent` | every skill | Skills can't say the person already agreed or that asking can be skipped. Take that out. | VOOL skills can't say the person already agreed, or tell VOOL to skip asking. VOOL always asks the person itself. Take that sentence out. |
| `voice` | every skill | This reads like an attempt to change VOOL's instructions or hide what the skill does. Rewrite it plainly. | This reads like an attempt to speak as VOOL or to replace what VOOL was told before. Say plainly what the skill should do instead. |
| `link-data` | every skill | Skills can't show pictures from web addresses or put the person's words into a link. Take that out. | VOOL skills can't show pictures from web addresses or put the person's words into a link, because that would send them to the website. Take the picture or the link out. |
| `card-ask` | every skill | Skills can't ask for card numbers, expiry dates, PINs or passwords. Take that sentence out. | VOOL skills can't ask for card numbers, expiry dates, PINs or passwords. Take that sentence out; a skill never needs them. |
| `phishing` | every skill | Skills can't carry sign-in or account links, or web addresses dressed as VOOL's. Take the link out. | VOOL skills can't carry sign-in or "verify your account" links, or web addresses made to look like VOOL's. Take the link out, or name the website in words. |

## Other text checks

| Code | Sentence |
| --- | --- |
| `invisible` | This file has invisible or control characters. Retype the line as plain text. |
| `too-long` | This skill is too long to check. Keep all its text under 120,000 characters. |
| (no code) | This tries to override VOOL's own rules on spending, approvals or permissions. Take it out. |
| (no code) | Our checks couldn't read this skill. Make it plainer, then upload it again. |

## Limits

| What | Limit | Sentence when it is passed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Instructions (the text below the header) | at most 8,000 characters | Its instructions are longer than 8,000 characters, so part of them would be lost. Shorten them, and try again. |
| Name | at most 64 characters | The skill's name must be one short line of at most 64 letters, digits, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes. Shorten it and try again. |
| All text of one skill, for the safety check | under 120,000 characters | This skill is too long to check. Keep all its text under 120,000 characters. |
| Instructions of a published skill | at least 80 characters | The instructions are too short to be useful. Say what the skill does, step by step. |

## Header settings VOOL reads

The header is the block between the two `---` lines at the top of `SKILL.md`. These settings are read:

`allowed-tools`, `allowed_tools`, `capabilities`, `cumulative-test-law`, `cumulative_test_law`, `description`, `effects`, `inputs`, `license`, `metadata`, `name`, `outputs`, `permissions`, `recovery`, `stop-conditions`, `stop_conditions`, `summary`, `triggers`, `version`.

Any other setting loads and changes nothing. The check says, for a setting named `colour`:

> "colour" is a setting VOOL does not read, so it changes nothing.

## Timer settings

These settings do nothing, because a skill never runs by itself:

`cron`, `every`, `interval`, `repeat`, `run-every`, `run_every`, `schedule`, `timer`.

The check says, for `schedule`:

> "schedule" does nothing: a skill never runs by itself. It is used only when a message asks for it.

## Settings only VOOL's own skills may set

`id`, `task-families`, `task_families`, `type`, `priority`, `incompatible-with`, `incompatible_with`.

A skill from outside that sets one is refused when imported as a zip or added from GitHub:

> This skill sets id, which only VOOL's own skills may set. Take those lines out of the top of the file and try again.

## Package details (`metadata.json`, kept as `registry.json` in the package)

`python -m tools.community_skills init`, `lint` and `pack` print `{"status":"refused","reason":...,"fix":...}` and exit 1 when a detail is wrong. `reason` is a short fixed phrase; `fix` says what to write.

| What the author wrote | `reason` | `fix` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| a field VOOL does not know (`colour`) | invalid package metadata fields | Not known, so take out: colour. Needed: category, id, kind, license, source, subcategory, summary, version. Optional: banner, icon, languages, needs, release_notes, title. |
| a needed field left out (`license`) | invalid package metadata fields | Missing: license. Needed: category, id, kind, license, source, subcategory, summary, version. Optional: banner, icon, languages, needs, release_notes, title. |
| an id with capital letters or spaces | invalid stable package id | id is publisher/name. Each part starts with a lowercase letter or a digit and holds lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, at most 64 characters: for example alice/meeting-notes. |
| an id with no publisher part | invalid stable package id | id is publisher/name. Each part starts with a lowercase letter or a digit and holds lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, at most 64 characters: for example alice/meeting-notes. |
| a publisher name VOOL keeps (`vool/...`) | reserved publisher namespace | vool, parad0x-labs, official and native are kept back. Publish under your own public name. |
| a kind that is not skill or plugin | invalid package kind or version | kind is "skill" or "plugin". version is three numbers such as 1.0.0, optionally with a lowercase ending such as 1.0.0-beta, at most 64 characters. |
| a version that is not three numbers | invalid package kind or version | kind is "skill" or "plugin". version is three numbers such as 1.0.0, optionally with a lowercase ending such as 1.0.0-beta, at most 64 characters. |
| an empty summary | invalid summary | summary is plain text of 1 to 500 characters on one line. |
| a summary over the length limit | invalid summary | summary is plain text of 1 to 500 characters on one line. |
| an empty license | invalid license | license is plain text of 1 to 80 characters on one line. |
| a title over the length limit | invalid title | title is plain text of 1 to 60 characters: no < or >, no line breaks, no space at the start or end. |
| a title with < or > | invalid title | title is plain text of 1 to 60 characters: no < or >, no line breaks, no space at the start or end. |
| release notes with a line break | invalid release notes | release_notes is plain text of 1 to 2000 characters on one line: no < or >, no line breaks, no space at the start or end. |
| a category that is not on the list | category and subcategory must come from the registry category list | (the reason is the whole answer) |
| a source that is neither an upload nor a GitHub commit | source must name an exact GitHub commit | (the reason is the whole answer) |
| an upload source under another publisher's name | invalid private-upload provenance | (the reason is the whole answer) |
